settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: We prepare orders quickly to protect freshness. If your order has not yet shipped, contact us with your order number and we will do our best to update or cancel it.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: A tracking link is sent to your email as soon as your order leaves our studio. You can also find tracking details in your order confirmation.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping typically arrives in 3–6 business days after dispatch. Express options, where available, usually arrive in 1–2 business days.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: Yes. International delivery times vary by destination, typically 6–12 business days once dispatched. Duties and taxes may apply depending on your region.

settings.question: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Many of our formulas are developed with sensitive skin in mind and are dermatologist tested. We recommend reviewing the ingredient list and patch testing if you have known sensitivities.

settings.question: How should I store my skincare products?
settings.answer: Keep products in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Close lids firmly after each use to help preserve texture and active ingredients.

settings.question: Do your products contain fragrance?
settings.answer: Some formulas are unscented, while others use a light, skin-friendly scent. Fragrance details are listed on each product page so you can choose what feels right for your routine.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. For hygiene reasons, opened skincare cannot always be accepted. Contact us and we will guide you through the next step.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Email us with your order number and the items you wish to return. Once approved, we will send a prepaid label and instructions.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept major credit cards, Shop Pay, PayPal and other secure payment methods offered at checkout. All transactions are encrypted.
